info.title: Ursainyk API
info.description: Nabhahita Phase 1 — candidates, ESM centres, contractors, review gate, matching, verification, billing. Authorization is role-based (see x-required-permission per operation); scoping (territory/org/own) is enforced server-side.

post.summary: Portal login (TOTP required for enrolled admins)
Rotate refresh token (reuse revokes the family)
Prove TOTP possession — enforced at next login
Create portal user (temp password returned once)
Admin password reset (temp password returned once)
Approve with optional corrections (auto-scores; training capture)
Confirm upload → ingestion pipeline (validate, scan, parse)
Post requirement (contractor own org; Sales on behalf)

get.summary: List: contractor=own, ESM=masked territory feed, admin=all
List (ESM territory / contractor supplied / candidate own)

post.summary: Submit immutable monthly fact (drives all money)
Run billing for a period (idempotent, append-only ledger)

put.summary: Write config key (flags = flags.*; audited SUPER)
